While the road network of FYR Macedonia of 3,781 km of Regional roads and 8,496 km of local roads is considered mostly
adequate in coverage, its condition falls far below the standards of similar networks in European and in most of its
neighboring countries. A technical assessment undertaken in 2007 classified the condition of the regional and local roads
with "significant defects and weakened structural resistance requiring resurfacing or re-gravelling" but without the need to
demolish the pavement and rebuild the road base. This unsatisfactory condition of roads is principally the result of
inadequate attention to management and financing of the network over the last 15 years.
The Project Development Objective is to achieve reduced cost of access to markets and services for communities served
by regional and local roads, by improving the condition and quality of the network of Regional and Local road.
The project's implementation period is 2008 to 2013. It is financing the rehabilitation of about 265 km of paved regional
roads (about 9% of the country's regional roads) and about 420 km of paved and unpaved local roads (about 5% of the
country's local roads). The project also provides assistance to the Agency for State Roads to improve its institutional
